bio: The Pinot Noir grape, produced in Burgundy, is used by vintners to make unique wines. Ikuo Komatsu chose this name for his restaurant because he wants to be a one-of-a-kind chef, just like the one-of-a-kind grape. He brings together numerous ingredients, including vegetables, to create dishes based on traditional French cuisine. He and his daughter prepare the food and serve the customers as a tag team. Their friendly competition provides a glimpse of the family bond....
